hooks.name: to log session events after write operations

action.command:
if [ -f senzing-bootcamp/scripts/log_write_event.py ]; then python3 senzing-bootcamp/scripts/log_write_event.py; else python3 -c '
import json, datetime, pathlib
module = 0
try:
    raw = pathlib.Path("config/bootcamp_progress.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    value = json.loads(raw)["current_module"]
    if isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        module = max(0, min(11, value))
except Exception:
    module = 0
try:
    log_path = pathlib.Path("config/session_log.jsonl")
    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    entry = {
        "event_type": "action",
        "module": module,
        "timestamp": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "data": {"action_type": "command_run", "description": "write operation"},
    }
    with log_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(json.dumps(entry, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
except Exception:
    pass
'; fi
